DISTRIBUTE.TITLE: Distribute tickets
DISTRIBUTE.DESCRIPTION: Share unsolved tickets equally among the agents you pick. Agents keep the tickets they already have, up to their equal share; only the rest moves.

AGENTS.HEADING: Agents to include ({n} picked) | Agents to include ({n} picked) | Agents to include ({n} picked)

EMAIL_ROUTING.TITLE: Email Routing
EMAIL_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: Choose which email inbox gets a new mail when it names more than one of our addresses or comes from a chosen sender.
EMAIL_ROUTING.INTRO: A new mail goes to the first inbox in this list that matches: its own address is on the mail, the sender is one of its senders, or one of its To/Cc addresses is on the mail. Replies always stay in their ticket. When the same mail reaches us through two mailboxes, it opens one ticket.
EMAIL_ROUTING.LOAD_FAILED: Could not load the email routing.
EMAIL_ROUTING.EMPTY: No inboxes listed. Every new mail goes to the inbox of the first of our addresses on it, as before.
EMAIL_ROUTING.NO_MEMBERS: No agents in this inbox yet: only administrators will see the mail sent here. Add agents in Settings → Inboxes → Collaborators before saving.
EMAIL_ROUTING.SENDERS_HINT: An address, or {'@'}domain for a whole domain and its subdomains. Press Enter to add.
EMAIL_ROUTING.RECIPIENTS: Also mail with these addresses in To or Cc
EMAIL_ROUTING.RECIPIENTS_HINT: For example an address of ours that forwards elsewhere, or a regulator the customer copied in.
EMAIL_ROUTING.EVERYTHING_ELSE: Any other mail goes to the inbox of the first of our addresses on it, as before.
EMAIL_ROUTING.SAVED: Email routing saved. New mail follows it from now on.
EMAIL_ROUTING.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

CHECK.TITLE: Try a mail
CHECK.DESCRIPTION: Type a sender and the To/Cc addresses to see which inbox a new mail would go to.
CHECK.RESULT_ADDRESS: → {inbox}: its own address is on the mail
CHECK.RESULT_DEFAULT: → {inbox}: no rule matches, so the first of our addresses decides (as before)
CHECK.RESULT_REFUSED: None of our addresses is on this mail, so Chatwoot would not take it.
CHECK.RESULT_INVALID: Those addresses could not be read.
CHECK.UNSAVED_NOTE: The check uses the list on screen, including changes not saved yet.
